SDN.note: No link between civil register and ID system stated.
National number issuance, not digital birth or death registration.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Number issued for children, but not stated as given when the birth is registered.
Police run the civil registry service, but operation, maintenance and ownership of the platform are not stated.
No other register keyed on the number stated.

facts.fact: The police press office, via the head of its technology and information department, said in November 2024 that national-number issuance for children had been launched in all civil registry centres at home and abroad, as the second phase of restoring the central system, with adults to follow.
facts.system: National number (General Administration of Civil Registry)

systems.owner: General Administration of Civil Registry, Police

SDN.note: No standards body or standard stated.
Identity number issuance only; no civil registration offices stated.
